newsitem.title: UK: Fortis will not bid for ScotAm - paper.
newsitem.headline: Fortis will not bid for ScotAm - paper.

text.p: Belgian-Dutch financial services group Fortis AG has decided not to bid for life insurance company Scottish Amicable, the Financial Times newspaper said on Wednesday.
ScotAm last month unveiled plans for a two-stage plan to drop its mutual status and seek a stock market listing.

Britain's Abbey National then announced a surprise 1.4 billion stg ($2.29 billion) bid for the company. Two other companies, Britain's Prudential Corp and Australian Mutual Provident (AMF), also entered the bidding contest.

Fortis was reported as another contender earlier this month, but decided against a bid because it is in the middle of an agreed takeover of Dutch merchant banking group MeesPierson, the Financial Times said.
